mapper.select: SELECT ku.user_id, u.nickname, u.avatar, ku.role, ku.created_at FROM kitchen__user ku LEFT JOIN user u ON ku.user_id = u.id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE ku.kitchen_id = #{kitchenId} AND ku.deleted = 0 ORDER BY ku.role ASC, ku.created_at ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE kitchen__user SET deleted = 0, deleted_at = NULL, role = #{role}, inviter_id = #{inviterId}, created_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 1
